text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear paragraphing with transitions like \"However,\" \"Anther reason,\" and \"Lastly\"","quality":"organization","description":"The essay groups ideas into a recognizable structure and uses signal words to move between points."},{"evidence":"multiple developed examples about a dress, a friend in trouble, and a school shooting","quality":"idea development","description":"The essay explains its position with several concrete scenarios instead of only repeating a general statement."},{"evidence":"complete argument built around a stance on honesty","quality":"coherence","description":"The writing stays focused on one main claim and supports it in a logically connected way."},{"evidence":"phrases like \"what if someone came up to you\" and \"that's when you could tell the principle\"","quality":"sentence control","description":"The essay shows more control in forming extended sentences that communicate ideas more clearly."},{"evidence":"formal opener \"An old proverb says honesty is the best policy\"","quality":"academic tone","description":"The essay sounds more essay-like and appropriate to a school argument task."}]}
